CPU/CUDA/Metal/GLSL implement the same fixed Philox words; native categorical ID equality is intentionally narrower than raw-word equality.

Mapping alignment checked before typed access; host visibility/close/first-error paths retained. Every categorical row validates before outputs are mapped/written. Validation/reduction finishes before status-guarded payload writes; launch return codes preserve an accepted prefix. External capture explicitly rejected; no new capture claim.

CPU compares the original Entry key and copies original value bytes, with no V-entry scratch at K1. Apple integer IEEE keys preserve subnormal/zero/NaN order and original native values, including the affected K>1 key path. Public Context/Invocation/array ownership unchanged; empty Binary fix runs only after schema/floating-domain checks.

Native descriptor_buffer rounds prefix+payload to buffer_capacity and rejects an insufficient padded range; byte-origin loads use that original checked path. Output ports are independent padded owners. Group/scratch limits checked, status dispatches ordered through original barriers/fence; no shaderInt64/Float64 requirement or host payload read. Graph changes are finite schema/arity whitelists.

Both over-aligned free paths call mi_free_aligned, retaining actual allocation-page identity when an aligned request crosses a small-page boundary. Natural<=16-byte path unchanged.
